text:
Priya (PM): New mock for Prompt Sets empty-run. Aim: make the empty state helpful not scary. Image: https://img.prod/mock/empty-run-3.png Alex (Design): Nice layout. Question on CTAs: should primary be 'Create prompt set' or 'Create a test'? Priya (PM): We use 'prompt set' elsewhere, but new users may not know that term. Alex (Design): Proposal: two actions primary 'Create prompt set' (promotes correct object), secondary 'Run sample test' (low effort). Jordan (Eng): Two buttons ok. We can wrap secondary behind a client flag if metrics show confusion. Sam (Accessibility): A11y items: when tray appears, trap focus and announce text. Use role="status" with aria-live="polite". Make sure buttons have clear aria-labels. Marco (Frontend): I'll implement focus-trap, aria-live region, and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also add visible focus outlines. Tay (Product): If user picks 'Run sample test', do we auto-create a prompt set? Jordan (Eng): Yes create a lightweight ephemeral prompt set and tag it so we can let users edit it in the run view. Backend will return ephemeral=true. Priya (PM): Microcopy: avoid 'click here'. For SR clarity use aria-label="Run sample test" while showing 'Quick run' visually. Alex (Design): I'll update Figma with two color tokens (high-contrast and subtle) and a keyboard nav gif. Marco (Frontend): Implementation snippet:
No runs yet 1 create a prompt set to start testing.
Sam (Accessibility): Keyboard flow: after creating a run, move focus to the new run card heading and announce results. Add accessible dismiss for the tray. Jordan (Eng): We'll gate the rollout behind feature flag empty_run_helptray_v3 so we can A/B copy. Track events: empty_run_create_prompt_set, empty_run_run_sample with property ephemeral=true/false. Priya (PM): Marco will open PR next week. Please review for copy, accessibility, and analytics. ux-bot: Design files uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/empty-run-variants
